field_principles.arc_inventory_complete_score: A complete score means provenance is inventoried, not that ARC was solved.
field_principles.configuration_strata: Distinct model, policy, budget, game, tool, and supervisor strata stay separate.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time exposes interrupted or skipped execution.
field_principles.experiment_id: The identifier binds the file to REQ-ARC-6843.
field_principles.field_principles: Each top-level field states why an auditor needs it.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A failed gate names the check, expected value, and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The terminal complete_ prefix states the evidence boundary.
field_principles.incomplete_artifact_manifest: Partial, missing, and unreadable files are ineligible.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate says this is a read-only inventory, not inference.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: The gates stop source drift before row eligibility is counted.
field_principles.process_observations: Live processes are recorded as observations, not evidence rows.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: One digest binds the non-timing inventory content.
field_principles.rows: One row per run and game keeps configurations separated.
field_principles.run_date: The date fixes this execution-time inventory.
field_principles.schema: The schema lets downstream readers reject incompatible inventories.
field_principles.solve_claim: False prevents an inventory from becoming a game solve claim.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: File hashes bind every terminal or missing source observation.
field_principles.status: The status separates a complete inventory from a blocked gate.
field_principles.supervisor_cells_ready_score: A count-derived readiness flag makes no effect claim.
field_principles.supervisor_eligible_cells: The exact supervisor receipt count drives readiness only.
field_principles.terminal_artifact_manifest: Terminal files are named without trusting their claims.
field_principles.tool_gap_cells_ready_score: A count-derived readiness flag makes no effect claim.
field_principles.tool_gap_eligible_cells: The exact tool-gap receipt count drives readiness only.
field_principles.unmatched_cell_reasons: Ineligible cells remain visible with a reason.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed verdict class prevents unsupported positives.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that this audit does not adjudicate solutions.

producer_configuration.honest_verdict: blocked: missing outcome-bearing live trajectory-supervisor receipts
complete: live receipt path reachable, firings inspected, no supported policy change

blocked: the canonical E3 action seam applied held-family redirects, but the archived transport has no exact outcomes after changed actions; no live-policy benefit, game solve, or level solve is claimed
blocked: held-family supervisor A/B is partial because verification_failure; no transition benefit or solve is claimed
complete: every applied held-family redirect has one exact live next-outcome row (30 eligible); this is transport evidence with no solve claim

random_seed.online_seed_limit: Arcade ONLINE does not transmit make(seed=...) to the remote wrapper
